verdict.rationale: YYLO is a CLI orchestrator for coding agents. It can have an agent analyze your repository from inside the tool, as in `yy pi --no-session 'Summarize this repository. Do not edit files.'`. Benchmark runs also produce bounded reports from retained evidence. There is no dedicated insights or suggestions feature: any analysis comes from prompting the delegated agent. Missing for 10: a built-in feature for AI insights or recommendations over user data (e.g. Ledger records or task history), docs describing what insights are surfaced, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
